summary: Create a shareable RooQuiz preview quiz — a right/wrong assessment where correct answers earn points and the taker gets a score — and get a link to open in the browser. No account, login, or API key required. Use this when someone wants to build, try out, or share a graded quiz, test, trivia, or exa
